FileHeader.rules: Place at the top of the file before any imports (namespaces). Include the file path for AI context.

ClassDescription.rules: Explain the class responsibility (e.g., Service, Controller, Model) and how it integrates into the application architecture.

PropertyDocumentation.rules: Crucial for Laravel Models to document database columns and relations, allowing IDEs to provide intellisense for 'magic' properties.

MethodDescription.rules: Focus on the 'WHY' and 'HOW' of the business logic. Do not describe obvious getters/setters unless there is custom logic inside.
